data.content_ref: inline:No-extension ceiling theorem: the grounded extension is the unique maximal skeptical semantics preserving all four guarantees (deterministic fixpoint, polynomial cost, reinstatement as derived, valid committed roots). For any monotone operator T properly extending the Pass 1 operator, there exists a finite argumentation framework where T either resolves a suspension the grounded extension keeps UNDECIDED (violating reinstatement-as-derived or determinism) or suspends a node the grounded extension accepts (violating skeptical minimality). This generalizes the SRC_005 counterexample from bounded-depth lookahead to every proper extension, making further expansion a dead end unless a guarantee is deliberately relaxed or reparameterized.
